home.hero.title.message: Everything you need to bill clients

home.hero.subtitle.message: Open-source invoicing for freelancers and small businesses. Run it on your own server, or use the hosted version — no per-client limits, ever.

home.meta.description.message: Documentation for Augias, the open-source invoicing platform for freelancers and small businesses. Installation guides, integrations, and API reference.

home.feature.quotes.description.message: Create professional quotes and invoices, send them to clients, and track their status from draft to paid.

home.feature.recurring.description.message: Automate retainer and subscription billing with flexible recurring invoice schedules.

home.feature.currency.description.message: Bill in any currency, configure tax rates per region, and apply discounts at line-item or invoice level.

home.feature.selfHosted.description.message: Run on your own server with Docker, Symfony, or pre-built binaries. Full control over your data.

home.feature.api.description.message: Integrate with your existing tools via the JSON-LD/HAL/JSON REST API powered by API Platform.

home.feature.openSource.description.message: MIT-licensed and built in the open. No per-client limits, no vendor lock-in, no surprises.

home.features.subtitle.message: Everything you need to manage clients, send invoices, and get paid.
